title: Global Email Layout
subtitle: The frame around every email: header, footer and global styles.

styles.title: Global styles (mj-head)
styles.description: Fonts, colors and other defaults applied to all emails, as MJML mj-head markup (mj-attributes, mj-style, mj-font). Applied to the canvas immediately, persisted when you save the layout.

toast.missingPlaceholder: The layout is missing the content placeholder.

resetConfirm.title: Reset layout to default?
resetConfirm.message: This will overwrite your customizations with the bundled default layout. This cannot be undone.
